compound.name: wogonoside (wogonin 7-O-glucuronide)
compound.one_liner: Glucuronide of wogonin, a major root flavone of Chinese skullcap.

identity.note: PubChem record title is 'Oroxindin' (synonym of wogonoside; CAS 51059-44-0 matches KNApSAcK's wogonoside).

occurrences.source_citation: Costine B, Zhang M, Chhajed S, Pearson B, Chen S, Nadakuduti SS (2022) Exploring native Scutellaria species provides insight into differential accumulation of flavones with medicinal properties. Sci Rep 12:13201
occurrences.database: Dr. Duke's Phytochemical and Ethnobotanical Databases
occurrences.note: Duke also WOGONIN-7-O-GLUCURONIDE Root 119-54000 ppm. Costine 2022: root 3.8 ± 0.9 mg/g. CIR/Cai 2016: 155 mg/g aqueous root extract. KNApSAcK C00004131. | Basis as recorded: ppm as listed by Duke (basis not stated per row; for 'Essent. Oil' parts it is ppm of the oil, 10000 ppm = 1 %) Basis (fresh/dry weight) not stated by the source; excluded from /compare until confirmed.

compound.teaching_note: Not the same as KNApSAcK's 'wogonin 7-glucoside' (a glucoside, C22H22O10): one sugar acid makes a different compound, which is why the lateriflora row was dropped.
gaps: S. lateriflora occurrence dropped (database hit was a different compound).
No human evidence for the isolated compound found in this pass.
